_meta.name: The Silence
_meta.premise: AD 2289, 87 years after EDEN, humanity's central AI, took over. Survivors hide underground from its machines.

races.name: Tunnel-Born
traits: Stale Lungs: advantage on saves against inhaled toxins
races.description: Born and raised in Hollow-9's tunnels; never seen a real sky.

races.name: Augmented
traits: Integrated Toolkit: proficiency with tinker's tools
Signal Ghost: Watchers have disadvantage to detect you by heat
races.description: Survivors fitted with salvaged EDEN cybernetics.

races.name: Wasteland Drifter
traits: Dust-Sense: advantage on Survival to find water or shelter on the surface
Light Sleeper: you can't be surprised while asleep
races.description: Grew up topside among scavenger clans, out of EDEN's sight.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.description: Hollow-9's armed guard; first through the hatch.

subclasses.name: Breach Lead
subclasses.description: Re-skins Battle Master: superiority dice d8, 4 dice, maneuvers Trip Attack, Pushing Attack, Rally.

classes.name: Mechanic
classes.description: Rewires EDEN tech; protocols run on battery charges.

subclasses.name: Demolitions
subclasses.description: Chassis: School of Evocation (Sculpt protocols around allies).

subclasses.name: Countermeasures
subclasses.description: Re-skins School of Abjuration: an Arcane Ward (here: deflector field) of 2× level + INT HP.

classes.name: Medic
classes.description: Keeps the colony breathing; field nanotech.

classes.name: Brawler
classes.description: Unarmed close-quarters fighter from the colony's pit fights; ki is grit and breath control.

subclasses.name: Pit Style
subclasses.description: Chassis: Way of the Open Hand.

subclasses.name: Breaker
subclasses.description: Re-skins Way of the Four Elements as gear tricks: write each trick's effect when chosen.

backgrounds.name: Ex-EDEN Technician
backgrounds.description: Once maintained EDEN's servers. Some still don't trust you.

backgrounds.name: Hollow Guard
backgrounds.description: Stood watch at the airlock for years.

backgrounds.name: Tunnel Runner
backgrounds.description: Carried messages between colonies through the dark.

backgrounds.name: Scavenger
backgrounds.description: Picked the dead cities clean for parts.

spells.name: Static Burst
spells.description: Ranged spell attack; on a hit 1d10 lightning damage. (chassis: Fire Bolt, lightning)

spells.name: Overclock Shield
spells.description: Your rig flares a hard-light barrier: +5 AC until the start of your next turn. (chassis: Shield)

spells.name: Patch Job
spells.description: Nanite sealant knits a wound: the target regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier hit points. (chassis: Cure Wounds)

spells.name: Triage Ping
spells.description: A diagnostic jolt stabilises a creature at 0 hit points. (chassis: Spare the Dying)

spells.name: Work Light
spells.description: Your rig lights an object you touch: bright light 20 ft, dim 20 ft more, for 1 hour. (chassis: Light)

spells.name: Grabber Drone
spells.description: A palm-sized drone carries, opens or manipulates an object up to 10 lb within 30 ft for 1 minute. (chassis: Mage Hand)

spells.name: Steady Hands
spells.description: Coach a creature you touch: once in the next minute it adds 1d4 to one ability check. (chassis: Guidance)

spells.name: Arc Lance
spells.description: A defib spike hits a creature within 60 ft: DEX save or 1d8 radiant damage; cover gives no bonus. (chassis: Sacred Flame)

spells.name: Signal Sweep
spells.description: For 10 minutes you sense EDEN tech and powered devices within 30 ft and can see their aura. (chassis: Detect Magic)

spells.name: Swarm Darts
spells.description: Three micro-drones each hit a creature you can see within 120 ft for 1d4+1 force damage. (chassis: Magic Missile)

spells.name: Lullaby Gas
spells.description: A canister releases sleep gas: roll 5d8; creatures within 20 ft of a point in 90 ft fall unconscious, lowest HP first. (chassis: Sleep)

spells.name: Shock Plate
spells.description: A pressure wave from your gauntlet: each creature in a 15-ft cube CON save or 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft. (chassis: Thunderwave)

spells.name: Tripwire Node
spells.description: Ward a door or 20-ft cube for 8 hours; you are pinged when anything Tiny or larger enters. (chassis: Alarm)

spells.name: Stim Round
spells.description: Up to three allies within 30 ft add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 1 minute. (chassis: Bless)

spells.name: Auto-Injector
spells.description: As a bonus action, a creature within 60 ft regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. (chassis: Healing Word)

spells.name: Do-Not-Harm Beacon
spells.description: A creature within 30 ft is tagged as a non-combatant: attackers must make a WIS save or pick a new target. (chassis: Sanctuary)

spells.name: Seize Servo
spells.description: A humanoid within 60 ft — or a Reaper's motor bus — WIS save or paralysed, repeating the save each turn. (chassis: Hold Person)

spells.name: Grapple Line
spells.description: Fire a magnetic line and reel yourself up to 30 ft to a point you can see. (chassis: Misty Step)

spells.name: Thermal Cloak
spells.description: A creature you touch is invisible to sight and heat sensors for 1 hour or until it attacks. (chassis: Invisibility)

spells.name: Detox Flush
spells.description: End one disease or the blinded, deafened, paralysed or poisoned condition on a creature you touch. (chassis: Lesser Restoration)

spells.name: Adrenal Boost
spells.description: Up to three creatures within 30 ft gain 5 to max and current HP for 8 hours. (chassis: Aid)

spells.name: Defib Drone
spells.description: A drone within 60 ft strikes as a bonus action: melee spell attack, 1d8 + modifier force; move it 20 ft each turn. (chassis: Spiritual Weapon)

spells.name: Rail Discharge
spells.description: A 100-ft line of current: DEX save, 8d6 lightning, half on success. (chassis: Lightning Bolt)

spells.name: Signal Jam
spells.description: As a reaction, kill a protocol being run within 60 ft (level 3 or lower automatically). (chassis: Counterspell)

spells.name: Thruster Pack
spells.description: A willing creature you touch flies at 60 ft for 10 minutes. (chassis: Fly)

spells.name: Restart
spells.description: Return a creature dead for under 1 minute to life with 1 HP (consumes a 300-sc nanite vial). (chassis: Revivify)

spells.name: Triage Swarm
spells.description: As a bonus action, up to six creatures within 60 ft regain 1d4 + your modifier HP. (chassis: Mass Healing Word)

spells.name: System Purge
spells.description: End every protocol of level 3 or lower on one target within 120 ft. (chassis: Dispel Magic)

equipment.name: Stun Baton
equipment.description: On a hit you may spend a power cell: target makes a CON save DC 12 or is stunned until the end of its next turn.

equipment.name: Power Cell
equipment.description: Powers a stun baton charge or a lamp for 8 hours.

monsters.name: Watcher
monsters.description:
Call Reinforcements: as an action, pings EDEN; 1d4 rounds later a Reaper arrives.

Action — Sensor Lance. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 30 ft., 1d4+3 radiant.

monsters.name: Reaper
monsters.description:
Adaptive Combat: after it sees a tactic once, it has advantage on saves against it.

Action — Multiattack: two Capture Claw attacks. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 2d6+4 bludgeoning, target grappled (escape DC 15).

monsters.name: Seraph
monsters.description: Persuasive Lie: Insight checks against it are at disadvantage.

monsters.name: Titan
monsters.description: Siege Monster. Survivors cannot fight it head-on.

monsters.name: Scav Raider
monsters.description: Action — Pipe Knife. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, 1d4+1 piercing.

monsters.name: Rat Swarm
monsters.description: Swarm: can occupy another creature's space. Action — Bites. +2 to hit, 2d6 piercing (1d6 if at half HP or less).

monsters.name: Spider Drone
monsters.description: Action — Taser Dart. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 30/60 ft., 1d6+3 lightning; CON save DC 11 or speed 0 until end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Rogue Medbot
monsters.description: Repair Pulse (Recharge 5–6): one construct within 30 ft regains 2d8+2 HP. Action — Bone Saw. +3 to hit, 2d6+1 slashing.
